verdict.rationale: Brave's first-party docs describe date-based filtering for Web Search, including a recency filter (`pd`, last 24 hours), and claim continuous crawling of billions of pages for fresh results, with real-time news search alongside. The core of the story, recency-filtered fresh results, is documented, but the deeper parts are not shown. Missing for 10: explicit custom start/end date-range syntax, any quantified index update frequency or crawl latency, and independent or hands-on corroboration of freshness.
